tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. The homepage opens on it and it alternates with `surface` between topics. Lessons and FAQ items on a `surface` section use it as their field.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels one step off the ground: cards, FAQ items, lesson modules, the consent dialog and alternating sections. Surfaces separate by this step in tone, never a line or shadow.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Inverse bands: the footer, inverse sections, the sticky bar and the Blueprint column in Comparison. Always with `data-surface="navy"`. In dark mode it is a lighter navy so the band still stands off `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-dark-alt
tokens.usage: Second inverse band: closing sections where they meet the footer, video posters, `ew-numbered` items on navy, and the nav (via `nav`).

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: The main navigation band. With `fg-on-dark` text.

tokens.name: portrait
tokens.usage: Black field that continues the teacher portrait's own background beside the photo. With `fg-on-dark` text.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body copy on `bg` and `surface` (light 12.3:1 and 11.1:1, dark 12.4:1 and 10.6:1).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, hints, runtimes and captions on `bg` and `surface` (5.1:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: fg-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, labels, figures and links on `bg` and `surface` (14.4:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: fg-on-dark
tokens.usage: Copy and headings on `surface-dark`, `surface-dark-alt`, `nav` and `portrait` (10.3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: fg-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and separators on navy bands (7.2:1 or better in both themes). Replaces every opacity-tinted white.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Text-field and consent-dialog borders on `bg` and `surface` (3:1 or better in both themes). Never a divider between sections.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions, with `accent-fg` text (13.4:1 light, 10.1:1 dark). Navy in light, a light blue in dark so the button still reads as the strongest thing on the page. Never a text or hover colour on navy. On a navy band the primary button inverts to `fg-on-dark` with `surface-dark` text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, with `accent-fg` text.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The brand's yellow, kept for one job: drawing the eye to something the reader must act on or know (form notices, the Badge `highlight` tone, the favicon bar). With `highlight-fg` text (10.9:1). Never for actions, headings, links or decoration.

tokens.name: highlight-fg
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight`, in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 3px, on `bg` and `surface` (14.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus outline inside `data-surface="navy"`.

tokens.name: brand-whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp mark on `bg` and `surface`, always beside a visible label (3.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: brand-whatsapp-on-dark
tokens.usage: WhatsApp mark on navy bands.

tokens.name: brand-youtube
tokens.usage: YouTube mark on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: brand-youtube-on-dark
tokens.usage: YouTube mark on navy bands.

tokens.name: brand-facebook
tokens.usage: Facebook mark on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: brand-facebook-on-dark
tokens.usage: Facebook mark on navy bands.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Opaque cover behind a modal dialog (the `<dialog>` backdrop). Never a tint: the dialog's `bg` panel and 1px `line` border set it apart.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Every page title (h1) and the footer wordmark: one shared scale. Fluid: clamp(2.75rem, 1rem + 4.5vw, 5rem), 44 to 80px, never smaller. Long titles wrap; they do not shrink.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: The closing section's heading only. Fluid: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 3.6vw, 4rem), 32 to 64px.
styles.sample: You've waited long enough to speak.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: `ew-data`: the one figure a section is about (prices, counts, countdown digits), tabular. Shares display-2's fluid size; it is the only use of that size outside the closing section.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Every section heading. Fluid: clamp(2rem, 1.3rem + 2.4vw, 3rem), 32 to 48px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subheadings, step titles, FAQ questions, aside and legal-page subsection headings, and the nav wordmark.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Reading copy, held to the 65ch `measure`. FAQ answers use 1.7 leading.
styles.sample: Sinhala supports the explanations; English is what you practice.

styles.name: body-bold
styles.usage: Lesson and module titles inside LessonRail, Comparison's Blueprint cells.
styles.sample: Why You Still Can't Speak English

styles.name: base
styles.usage: Navigation, controls, hints, captions and metadata. The floor for any text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: `ew-label`: a group or field label. Sentence case, never a kicker above a heading.

spacing.note: A named step scale for component internals, then the section rhythm, which steps up at 640px and 1024px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside a row of links.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field; icon to label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Step title to its body; card rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs; between form fields; `ew-numbered` gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Compact card padding; FAQ and lesson summaries' vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Heading to copy; FAQ horizontal padding; `ew-numbered` item padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Before actions; between footer columns.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Footer wordmark to columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between steps in StepRail.

tokens.name: section-space
tokens.usage: `ew-section` vertical padding on phones. Each section owns its full padding.

tokens.name: section-space-sm
tokens.usage: `section-space` from 640px.

tokens.name: section-space-lg
tokens.usage: `section-space` from 1024px.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: `ew-section-grid` gap when stacked.

tokens.name: section-gap-lg
tokens.usage: `section-gap` from 1024px.

tokens.name: panel-space
tokens.usage: `ew-panel` padding (Card, FactsBox) on phones.

tokens.name: panel-space-lg
tokens.usage: `panel-space` from 1024px.

radius.note: 2px is the maximum. Panels and cards are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and text fields. Nothing is rounder.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls and overlays (dialogs, toasts, the checkbox box). The same 2px as `radius-sm`.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every link target, footer included.

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs, compact buttons too.

tokens.name: container-page
tokens.usage: Full-width content cap.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Prose pages: /help, /privacy and /terms.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Body-copy measure (`ew-measure`).

tokens.name: heading-measure
tokens.usage: Default headline wrap width (SectionHeading and every section h2).

tokens.name: heading-measure-wide
tokens.usage: Wider headline wrap width.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a ListRow, the same as `tap-min`.

tokens.name: dialog-max
tokens.usage: Width of a dialog, never wider than the screen minus `space-4` each side.

tokens.name: toast-max
tokens.usage: Width of a toast, never wider than the screen minus `space-4` each side.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Interface icon beside a visible label, and brand marks.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Interface icon that is the whole control, inside a `tap-min` target with an `aria-label`.

duration.note: Motion is colour changes on controls and the sticky bar's slide. prefers-reduced-motion removes both.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour changes on buttons and links.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The sticky bar sliding in and out.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: All transitions.

meta.note: Refined ahead of the code: dark theme, highlight and nav are new; the site's tokens.css still has the old set until the code phase.
